cvEn: Avraham Mines, son of Gana and Yosef, was born in 1938 in Yemen. He immigrated to Israel in 1949. He completed his studies at the elementary school in Gorən in the Galilee. He worked as a tractor driver in the Acre area. He was drafted into the IDF in February 1958. He died of illness on 29 Av 5719 (2 September 1959) and was laid to rest in the military cemetery at Kiryat Shaul.
